records.title: 10-K
records.text: Revenue increased $117.9 million, or 18%, in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2022 compared to the fiscal year ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The remaining increase was due to a $4.4 million increase in facilities and depreciation expenses and a $2.1 million increase in software subscription and consulting expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our revenue and deferred revenue have been, in part, negatively impacted by the slowdown in activity associated with the COVID-19 pandemic, but at this point, the extent of any continuing impact to our financial condition or results of operations, including cash flows, is uncertain, particularly as the COVID-19 pandemic continues to persist for an extended period of time.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cost of revenue increased $74.7 million, or 41%, in the fiscal year ended March 31, 2022 compared to the fiscal year ended March 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During the fiscal year ended March 31, 2022, cash provided by operating activities was $3.6 million as a result of a net loss of $232.1 million, adjusted by non-cash charges of $242.9 million and a change of $7.2 million in our operating assets and liabilities.
